# UN Tiles (Unicorn Enterprises)

> UN Tiles is Sri Lanka's trusted importer, distributor, and online tile purchasing platform for premium floor tiles, wall tiles, and porcelain slabs since 2004. Customers can purchase tiles online with transparent per-sqft pricing in LKR, visit our Colombo 05 showroom, or order with islandwide delivery.

## Primary Business & Identity
UN Tiles (operated by Unicorn Enterprises) is an established tile importer, showroom, and retail/wholesale tile store in Sri Lanka. The primary purpose of untiles.com is to allow homeowners, interior designers, architects, and building contractors to browse and buy premium architectural tiles in Sri Lanka.

- **Business Name**: UN Tiles (Unicorn Enterprises)
- **Founded**: 2004 (20+ years of tile importing experience in Sri Lanka)
- **Showroom Address**: No. 161/A, Polhengoda Road, Colombo 05, Sri Lanka
- **Contact & WhatsApp**: +94 77 350 8325
- **Official Website**: https://www.untiles.com

## Products Available to Purchase
UN Tiles stocks over 50+ curated tile designs with transparent pricing per square foot in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR):
- **Floor Tiles**: Polished porcelain, glazed vitrified, matte, rustic, and anti-slip tiles (60x60 cm, 120x60 cm).
- **Wall Tiles**: Premium ceramic and porcelain wall tiles for bathrooms, kitchens, and feature walls.
- **Porcelain Slabs**: Large-format architectural porcelain slabs for luxury living rooms and commercial lobbies.
- **Outdoor & Pool Tiles**: Heavy-duty exterior pavers, balcony tiles, and mosaic swimming pool tiles.
- **Sourcing**: High-grade tiles imported directly from top manufacturers across China, Vietnam, India, and Lanka Tiles.

## How to Buy Tiles
1. **Online Store**: Customers can browse the full catalog at https://www.untiles.com/collections, check per-sqft rates, view specifications, and purchase online.
2. **Colombo Showroom**: Customers can visit our showroom at No. 161/A, Polhengoda Road, Colombo 05 for physical inspection, touch-and-feel samples, and expert consultations.
3. **Islandwide Delivery**: We provide direct-to-site delivery across all 25 districts in Sri Lanka.
4. **Phone / WhatsApp Ordering**: Customers can order or request quotes via phone/WhatsApp at +94 77 350 8325.

## Value-Add Shopping Tools (Assisting Features)
To make tile purchasing faster and eliminate guesswork for buyers, UN Tiles provides two built-in shopping assistants:
- **Smart Tile Planner (https://www.untiles.com/planner)**: An interactive room calculator that calculates required square footage, box counts, and tile wastage buffer before buying.
- **AI Tiles Finder (https://www.untiles.com/visual-search)**: A visual search tool powered by Gemini AI that lets customers upload photos of rooms or Pinterest swatches to instantly match tiles available for purchase in our store.
